ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the food web diagram, an arrow can be seen between Grasshopper and Mouse; the arrow points from Grasshopper to Mouse, indicating that the mouse eats the grasshopper or depends on the grasshopper as a food source. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows usually indicate energy flowing from the food/prey to the consumer/predator. If all grasshoppers die, the mouse will lose a food source, so the mouse population will decrease.
